messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Jul 01, 2020, Jatin Kashyap wrote:
>  NTX / IREST inconsistency
> ntx=1,            ! Positions and velocities read formatted
> irest=1,          ! Restart calculation
This is expected: restarts require velocities; setting ntx=1 says that
you don't have velocities.
....dac
